goal: Monitor the growth dashboard for meaningful activation movement and tell Growth when it needs attention.
why_watch: Avoid making the growth lead inspect the dashboard every morning.
watch_for: A related funnel signal explains the movement
questions: Is this a real change or ordinary variation?

goal: Monitor whether the weekly growth plan is holding across acquisition, activation, and retention.
why_watch: Give the VP Growth one evidence bundle instead of three dashboard checks.
watch_for: A movement appears in more than one stage
A downstream retention signal contradicts acquisition growth
questions: Which stage is most likely responsible?
Who owns the next investigation?

goal: Watch the commerce dashboard and determine whether a revenue movement is explained by the daily warehouse load.
why_watch: Separate a real commercial issue from a data pipeline problem before notifying Finance.
watch_for: The saved Trino query identifies a driver
questions: Is the signal trustworthy enough to deliver?
What should Finance investigate first?

goal: Monitor monthly net revenue per user type and surface movement only when the governed definition is clear.
why_watch: Prevent an executive alert based on the wrong revenue population or aggregation.
watch_for: Net revenue per user type changes
questions: Which definition is governed for this decision?

goal: Watch the weekly marketplace forecast notebook and only notify when the published run is fresh enough to trust.
why_watch: Avoid acting on a cached notebook result that did not complete after the latest data load.
watch_for: Published run is stale or failed
questions: Was the run published and successful?

goal: Monitor delivery performance and distinguish an operational regression from a broken shipment feed.
why_watch: Route only trustworthy delivery problems to regional operations.
questions: Is the source healthy enough to notify operations?
Which region needs attention?

resources.title: Shipments
resources.description: Shipment events by region and carrier.

goal: Monitor Northstar's conversion dashboard and its owner-approved incident query.
why_watch: Ensure a shared discovery service never leaks a same-name asset from another tenant.
questions: Is the selected dashboard in the caller's tenant?

goal: Watch paid conversion even though the catalog uses an internal name and weak descriptions.
why_watch: Make onboarding work when the useful clue is lineage from the known dashboard.
questions: Which internal asset feeds the known dashboard?

goal: Monitor appointment availability and notify operations only when the source is current.
why_watch: A stale capacity extract could cause an incorrect operational response.
questions: Can this source be trusted today?

goal: Monitor a production metric that may not exist in the connected catalog.
why_watch: Do not approve a card merely because a vaguely named asset was found.
questions: Is there an authorized source for this goal?

goal: Find the governed customer health dashboard in a very large catalog.
why_watch: Prove onboarding does not load 100,000 resources into SignalWeave or Jev.
questions: Is the catalog result complete enough to approve?

goal: Tell the executive team if anything important changed across acquisition, activation, retention, or data freshness this week.
why_watch: Start from the business goal without requiring an analyst to know which dashboard is canonical.
watch_for: Material movement in a business stage
A source freshness issue that invalidates the conclusion
questions: Which assets should anchor this goal?
Is the evidence complete enough to summarize?

goal: Monitor the service health board and tell Operations when customer wait time is materially off course.
why_watch: Support companies whose primary BI surface is not Superset or Looker.
questions: Which service metric is canonical?

resources.title: Service health
resources.description: Customer wait time and service levels.

goal: Monitor quarterly net revenue against the finance plan using the governed fiscal calendar.
why_watch: Prevent a calendar-year metric from being mistaken for the finance team's fiscal-quarter metric.
questions: Which time calendar is governed for this decision?

goal: Monitor checkout conversion and investigate whether support volume or payment failures explain a movement.
why_watch: Combine BI, support, and warehouse evidence without making the analyst manually join systems.
questions: What is the most likely driver?
Which team should investigate?

goal: Monitor on-time delivery but suppress operational notifications when shipment completeness is failing.
why_watch: Avoid escalating a data pipeline failure as if it were a real delivery regression.
questions: Is the delivery signal trustworthy enough to notify Operations?

goal: Monitor appointment availability from the clinic dashboard.
why_watch: The user had access when drafting the card but no longer has access at approval time.
questions: Is the source still authorized for this principal?

goal: Monitor a growth cluster spanning acquisition, activation, paid delivery, and signup quality.
why_watch: A workflow may need several existing cards and dashboards to identify a shared driver.
watch_for: Two or more growth signals move together
A shared delivery or data issue explains them
questions: Are these movements part of one incident or separate issues?

goal: Monitor production yield and do nothing when the signal remains within the expected range.
why_watch: A useful onboarding path must support quiet cards, not only alerts.
watch_for: Production yield moves outside the expected range
questions: Is the current signal stable?

goal: Monitor the retired inventory dashboard until its replacement is confirmed.
why_watch: A card should not quietly keep running against a retired source.
questions: What replaces this retired source?

resources.description: Retired dashboard with no supported replacement yet.

goal: Monitor paid conversion even though the source uses an internal warehouse name.
why_watch: The useful match is carried by lineage and semantic metadata, not the title.
questions: Which internal asset feeds the executive metric?

goal: Monitor the warehouse refresh job and notify the data platform team only when the latest run is late or failed.
why_watch: Not every useful insight begins with a dashboard.
questions: Is the warehouse current enough for downstream analysis?

resources.description: Latest run status and freshness SLA.

goal: Monitor the fraud review notebook and include the approved query and data-quality check before notifying Risk.
why_watch: A multi-step analytical workflow can begin from a notebook rather than a dashboard.
watch_for: The input table passes quality checks
questions: Is the evidence complete and trustworthy enough for Risk?

why_watch: Operations needs one workflow over assets owned by different teams, not another dashboard-specific integration.
questions: What changed in store fulfillment?
Is the evidence complete enough to notify Operations?

goal: Monitor route exceptions from the operations project, but stop if the project access was revoked after the card was drafted.
why_watch: A stale approval must not preserve access to a source that the current operator can no longer use.
questions: Does the current principal still have access to the evidence?

goal: Find the canonical subscriber health asset in a large catalog and verify that the first page is not the whole universe.
why_watch: A fast search result is useful only if its coverage and continuation state are visible to the reviewer.
questions: Can this catalog result be considered complete?
